top_risks.risk: THE WISEMAN LANE'S PINS ARE BROKEN FOR ANY FRESH CLONE (commit-time CRLF→LF normalization vs raw-download pins).
top_risks.evidence: tools/science_funnel/data/wiseman2026/models/Macaque_model.osim: committed bytes 375,571 (sha256 35e5235c…), pin says 381,616 (sha256 d5c65cbc…) — delta EXACTLY 6,045 = the file's LF count (committed file has 6,045 LFs, 0 CRLFs). wiseman's base fc45106c carries only enumerated -text rules, no blanket `tools/science_funnel/data/** -text`, so `* text=auto` normalized at commit while sha256_manifest.json pinned the raw downloads. All 12 test_wiseman_osim tests ERROR on this fresh clone with source_pin_drift; they passed on the lane because the lane worktree still held the raw bytes. This is the mirror image of the defect matter A already repaired for morphosource_ct ('source_obj_sha256 canonicalized to the committed LF bytes — the verifier's fresh clone refused and was RIGHT'). FIX before master integration: apply the matter-A repair pattern to wiseman2026 (canonicalize the recorded pins to the committed LF bytes) or commit the raw bytes under a -text rule.

top_risks.risk: RUNNING THE SCIENCE_FUNNEL SUITE MUTATES COMMITTED EVIDENCE IN-TREE.
top_risks.evidence: After each tools/science_funnel/tests run, 15 committed evidence files under tools/science_funnel/validation/visual_proof_20260917/ and visual_proof_wave2_20260918/ (PNGs + manifest.json) were regenerated with the LOCAL environment's stamps (producer python 3.14.3 / zlib 1.3.1.zlib-ng vs recorded 3.11.15 / 1.3.2). Both runs in this rehearsal re-dirtied them; both were `git checkout --`-restored BEFORE the next merge/commit. An integrator who runs the suite before committing will contaminate the integration commits with machine-local evidence — on master this would be silent evidence forgery.
